material.goal: Pressure-test and refine one machine-readable Ontology Vault semantic source from which deterministic human and machine views are derived, while preserving authoring usability, migration, and authority boundaries.
material.context: The user confirmed a candidate-local Refine strategy with three read-only specialist lanes. Current Ontology Vault owns lifecycle, confidence, PromotionRecord, and a governed candidate entry schema, but lacks an admitted semantic-package, normalization, projection-receipt, authoring, and migration contract. The parent will synthesize only after all three specialist receipts are joined and closed; no public or adopter source may be mutated.

predicted_disagreements.statement: Agent 0 formally optimizes schema closure and canonical identity while agent 1 empirically optimizes authoring and semantic-diff usability on the methodology axis; a bias toward structural purity in agent 0 would be exposed by agent 1's end-to-end human workflow witnesses.

Agent 0 formally treats a valid content-addressed package as the structural center while agent 2 adversarially tests owner admission, migration, rollback, and promotion on the methodology axis; a bias toward validity-as-sufficiency in agent 0 would be exposed by agent 2's authority and lifecycle counterexamples.

Agent 1 empirically favors convenient correction and projection workflows while agent 2 adversarially rejects view writeback, private leakage, and compatibility shortcuts on the methodology axis; a bias toward usability-over-governance in agent 1 would be exposed by agent 2's negative migration and authority witnesses.

agents.angle: formally derives closed package schemas, canonicalization, stable identity, relation constraints, and version compatibility
agents.initial_prompt:
You are one read-only specialist in the confirmed Ontology Vault machine-semantic-source refinement. Read only the exact source paths named below. Separate observed source facts from inference. Do not edit files, use external network research, resolve owner decisions, or claim canonical/public/implemented/promoted state. Return: (1) source selectors and observed facts, (2) candidate recommendation, (3) representation comparison where relevant, (4) finite positive and negative witnesses, (5) rejected alternatives with reasons, (6) claim ceiling, (7) residue and reroute.

Primary question: What is the smallest closed, modular SemanticPackage and SchemaSuite that reuses the current Ontology Vault entry/lifecycle model and supports deterministic normalization? Compare closed JSON, constrained JSON-LD, and typed authoring compiled to canonical JSON under one rubric: local closure, canonicalization, stable IDs, schema composition, graph semantics, semantic diff quality, portability, and migration.
